basic_info.description: Welcome to 9 Lobos St, San Francisco, CA 94112 a hidden gem offering breathtaking overlooking views, a private backyard, and an inviting blend of comfort and functionality. Located in the vibrant city of San Francisco, this spacious 1,726 sq. ft. home features four generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms, making it perfect for a growing family. The home boasts open spaces filled with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The well-appointed kitchen provides ample space for cooking and dining, ensuring a delightful experience for home chefs. This property offers plenty of room for outdoor activities and relaxation in the private backyard. Nestled in a quiet and family-friendly area, 9 Lobos St provides convenient access to local amenities, top-rated schools, and excellent transportation options. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a spacious home with stunning views, modern comforts, and outdoor living potential!
